_note: One line under the verdict stamp on each calculator, by result: healthy, watch, high. Brock approves these. Plain bar GM voice, no em dashes.

food-cost.healthy: Right where it should be. Keep counting weekly so it stays there.
food-cost.watch: Drifting. Check portions on the line before you touch prices.
food-cost.high: Food is eating the margin. Start with portions, then waste, then prices.

recipe-cost.healthy: Priced with room to breathe. Write the spec down so it stays that way.
recipe-cost.watch: Tight plate. One supplier increase and this one is underwater.
recipe-cost.high: This plate is priced like a favor. Recost it or raise it.

labor-cost.healthy: The schedule is earning its keep. Don't let overtime creep in.
labor-cost.watch: A little heavy. Look at the slow shifts first.
labor-cost.high: Too many people on the clock for these sales. Cut by the hour, not the head.

tip-pool.healthy: Clean split. Post the math so nobody has to ask.
tip-pool.watch: Tip credit means tighter rules. Keep the pool front of house.
tip-pool.high: Something in this pool breaks the rules. Fix it before payday.

prime-cost.healthy: Prime cost in the zone. This is the number that keeps the doors open.
prime-cost.watch: Edging up. Food or labor, one of them is slipping.
prime-cost.high: Prime cost this high eats the rent. Find which half moved.

menu-pricing.healthy: Good price. The plate pays for itself and then some.
menu-pricing.watch: It works, but there is not much cushion if costs move.
menu-pricing.high: Priced too close to cost. This one sells and loses.

liquor-pour-cost.healthy: Clean bar. Buy your bartender a shift drink.
liquor-pour-cost.watch: Pours are getting generous. Jiggers on the well.
liquor-pour-cost.high: That bottle is walking out the door. Count it, then jigger everything.

keg-cost.healthy: Every pint is paying. Keep the lines clean.
keg-cost.watch: Foam and free pints add up. Check the taps.
keg-cost.high: Too much of this keg is going down the drain or out for free. Find it.

fountain-cost.healthy: Clean pour. This drink is paying the rent.
fountain-cost.watch: Refills are creeping in. Watch the cup size.
fountain-cost.high: This drink is a giveaway. Cap refills or raise the price.

inventory-variance.healthy: Counts and sales line up. Keep doing what you're doing.
inventory-variance.watch: Small gap. Usually a miscount or a missed invoice. Check those first.
inventory-variance.high: That gap is real money. Count again, then watch the bar.

break-even.healthy: Plenty of cushion above break-even. Good place to be.
break-even.watch: Close to the line. One slow month puts you under.
break-even.high: You're under break-even. Something has to give: sales, rent or labor.

delivery-profit.healthy: Delivery is actually making you money. Protect it.
delivery-profit.watch: Thin. The apps are taking most of the margin.
delivery-profit.high: You're paying to deliver this order. Raise delivery prices or drop the item.

catering-pricing.healthy: Good margin per head. Book more of these.
catering-pricing.watch: Thin for the work. Check labor and rentals.
catering-pricing.high: This event costs more than it pays. Rework the quote.

turnover-cost.healthy: Low turnover. Your crew wants to be there. Keep it that way.
turnover-cost.watch: Turnover is costing real money. Post the schedule on time.
turnover-cost.high: You're paying to train people who leave. Fix their first 30 days.

no-show-deposit.healthy: No-shows are under control. A deposit policy keeps it that way.
no-show-deposit.watch: Empty seats are adding up. Time to think about deposits.
no-show-deposit.high: No-shows are eating a real chunk of sales. Take deposits.

menu-engineering.healthy: Strong menu mix. Feature the Stars and leave them alone.
menu-engineering.watch: Some dead weight. Rework the Puzzles, cut the Dogs.
menu-engineering.high: Too many Dogs. Shorten the menu.
